review.imagery: Root reviewed both complete brochure indexes, all seven original extracted scenes and the separate Rove 2 approach. Six gallery entries use the original building front/corner, apartment living, lobby, bedroom and Rove 2 approach. Madar community photography and phase-unresolved branded gym imagery are excluded from the project gallery, as are other-city hotel and generic brand portraits.
review.floorPlans: Root visually reviewed all14 staged complete spreads and all12 enlarged visible numeric panels. Twelve delivered choices include every original type in both brochures, separate first–ninth building floors, red footprint masters and community maps. Rove 2 has a 3BR A1/A2 pair while the original has 2BR A2/3BR A1. Areas manually read with brochure identity preserved. Both unedited PDFs and physical-page links remain available.
review.location: Root reviewed both distinct red building footprints, both developer community markers and regional context maps. Community estimates2/3/5/20 minutes retained with unspecified mode. Surveyed entrances and kilometre journeys remain unavailable. No coordinate inferred.
review.provenance: Both developer-hosted original PDFs and current category HTML were obtained with normal GET. Separate dated receipts retain original URL, bytes and SHA256 for the15,132,610-byte original and19,860,232-byte Rove 2 PDF. Canonical research and protected identity preserved.

unavailable: Surveyed entrances, kilometre journeys, current routes, final finishes and contracted unit revision remain unverified. Original Rove Home and Rove 2 type labels and areas represent different brochure/building scopes.
